title: Revoke refuses an agent by its self-declared client name, so it is both evadable and too broad
trigger: Settings > Agent access: Disconnect an agent connected as 'Claude Code' (or one that sent no client name, shown 'An agent'). server.rs authenticate() takes the name from the unauthenticated-by-identity 'client' param; revoke() pushes that name into REFUSED and serve() checks activity::refused(&agent).
effect: The revoked process still holds the valid token and reconnects under any other --client name and is accepted; meanwhile every other agent that reports the same name (a second Claude Code session, or every nameless agent as 'An agent') is refused until the user clicks Allow again or restarts.
fix: Make the connection identity an id minted by Quill (and a token per client, or revoke = reset token); refuse by that identity, and show name only as a label.

title: Failed save of agent grants is only logged, the cache keeps the new value
trigger: User removes a chat grant (or turns All chats off) while agent_grants.json cannot be written (disk full, read-only); the Settings page shows it revoked
effect: Agents are refused this run; after restart the old grant is read back from disk and the revoked chat is readable again with no sign to the user
fix: Make change_all return Result and have the Settings page show the save error; keep the cache equal to what is on disk.

title: resources/subscribe is lost silently when the bridge reconnects
trigger: Agent subscribes to quill://unread; Quill restarts or Agent access is toggled off and on; the next forwarded call opens a new link
effect: The old server-side watcher stopped with its connection and nothing resubscribes, so the agent believes it is subscribed and never hears about new messages
fix: Keep the subscription as bridge state (subscribed: Set<Uri>) and replay it on open_link, or tell the agent with an error when the link it subscribed on died.

title: A write that already went out is reported to the agent as 'Agent access is off'
trigger: Agent calls send_message; the user turns Agent access off (or presses Revoke) while the tool runs; the tool finishes the send, then Reply::drop replaces its result with the ACCESS_OFF error
effect: The agent is told its action did not run though the message was sent, and may retry it after access is back on, sending twice
fix: Let a finished tool result win for write tools (send the result with a note that access went off) or make Reply carry whether the call had side effects.

title: Chat class cache (OwnChannel/Bot/Saved) is process-wide, never invalidated and never pruned
trigger: An agent reads the user's channel (class OwnChannel, covered by the own-channels default). The user then transfers ownership or leaves it. The agent calls again.
effect: classify returns the cached OwnChannel, so the grant default keeps applying to a channel the user no longer owns until Quill restarts. The maps also keep an entry per (client, chat) for every closed client.
fix: Key the cache by the live Client and drop it with the client (or do not cache OwnChannel and re-read the supergroup status per call).

title: A write waits up to two minutes for a click after the agent has gone away
trigger: Agent calls send_message with Confirm each send on, then cancels the request or disconnects (not revoked); the user later clicks Allow within 120 s
effect: The message is sent for a call nobody waits on; the agent never sees the result and may send it again
fix: Tie the prompt to the call: withdraw it when the connection closes or the request is cancelled and check that in still_allowed.

title: One failed message in an album or forward fails the whole call although the others were delivered
trigger: Agent calls send_file with 3 to 10 files or forward_messages with many ids and one slot ends Sent::Failed while others succeed
effect: The call returns an error, the log records ok=false with no message_ids (so nothing can be undone), and the agent retries, sending duplicates
fix: Return a per-message outcome list (Delivered/Failed) and log the delivered ids; error only when none was delivered.

title: A send that Telegram has not delivered in 30 s is reported and logged as sent with its temporary message id
trigger: Agent sends a message while the network is slow (no updateMessageSendSucceeded within DELIVERY_WAIT), then the user opens the activity log and clicks undo or the agent edits/deletes by the returned id
effect: The tool answers ok with a local temporary id; the activity row stores that id in message_ids, so undo/open acts on a stale id (nothing, or an error) after the message gets its final id, and a later failure of the send is never reported
fix: Make the send result an enum Delivered(final) / Failed / StillSending(temp id) and log StillSending as such, resolving the id when the update arrives instead of storing the temp id.

title: Adding a chat to a folder rewrites the whole folder from a read taken before the queue turn
trigger: User edits the folder (renames it, adds chats) in Quill or another device while the agent runs set_chat_folder (getChatFolder happens before take_write_turn, which can wait on the paced queue)
effect: editChatFolder sends the stale folder back and silently undoes the user's folder change
fix: Do the read inside the same queue turn as the write, or send only a delta; re-read right before editChatFolder.

title: A command the UI already ran is reported as a timeout and the agent retries it
trigger: UI thread injects a click or keys, then takes more than 15 s to settle or answer; Ticket::wait sets cancelled after the injection and returns Timeout
effect: Tool says the window did not answer; the agent retries, so a toggle or a send click runs twice
fix: Make the stage one enum (Queued, Running, Answered, Abandoned) and report 'ran, answer lost' when Running at timeout.

title: testmode adds the account first and marks it test second; a failed marker write leaves a production account named 'Test environment'
trigger: On the sign-in screen of the only account type testmode; the account store is added (add_account saves the registry), then the marker write fails (disk full, read-only folder, antivirus lock). The user gets the 'could not switch the environment' note.
effect: The registry keeps a second, signed-out account called 'Test environment' that connects to production (no marker). The account count is now 2, so plan_test_mode returns None and the testmode code never works again until the user removes that account by hand; signing in there puts a production login under a test name.
fix: Write the marker before the account is registered (or roll back with remove_account on error), so 'registered' and 'environment known' are one step; better, store the environment in the AccountRecord as an enum Environment{Production,Test}.

title: Release sends the pinned list as it was when the drag began, not as it is now
trigger: Start dragging a pinned chat; while holding, another device unpins chat X (or pins Y); release
effect: finish_pin_drag sends setPinnedChats with the begin-time snapshot: X is pinned again, Y is unpinned
fix: On release merge the dragged order into session.pinned_chat_ids (drop ids no longer pinned, keep new ones in place), or cancel the drag when the pinned set changes.

title: A drag whose release never reaches the list keeps dragging set and asks a frame every 60 ms
trigger: Begin a pinned drag, then Alt-Tab or lose the pointer capture so neither mouse_up nor mouse_up_out fires
effect: settled() stays false and sidebar upkeep (chat_list/sidebar.rs:325) keeps calling request_animation_tick(60) while dragging is Some, even when the window is inactive; the row stays lifted
fix: Cancel the reorder (release without saving) on window deactivation or when no button is down in the next move event.

title: Permission continuation re-runs a plain starter and is not matched to the ask
trigger: On macOS with the microphone undetermined, press Answer on a ringing call twice (or toggle the call camera twice) while the system prompt is up, then allow.
effect: Each press spawns a poller; after the grant each runs the starter. answer_call runs accept_call twice (second gives 'Could not answer the call'), flip_call_camera flips twice (camera ends off). If the caller hung up or another call rings meanwhile, answer_call accepts whatever call is tracked now, not the one asked.
fix: A PermissionAsk { what, call_id } value held in one Option; a second press while it is Some is ignored and the continuation checks the same call id is still current before starting.

title: Country box says Loading countries forever when getCountries fails
trigger: Open the poll Allowed countries or the shipping country box while offline or when getCountries errors.
effect: fetch_countries result is dropped (let _ =) and an error answer leaves auth_state.countries None; an empty list renders as Loading countries... with no retry or error until the box is reopened.
fix: Use Fetch<Vec<Country>> for the list so failed shows an error row with Retry.

title: The tag-name box is not per_window, so a tag menu used in a chat window opens the box in the main window
trigger: Open Saved Messages in a chat window, right-click a tag chip on a message, Add Name.
effect: dialogs.saved_tag_dialog is account-level and the SavedTagName spec has no per_window(), so the box appears over the main window (and Save acts from there) instead of the window that asked.
fix: Own the tag-name box in the asking window's state (ChatUi/message_ui) and mark the spec per_window.

title: Debug mode switch keeps three copies (in-memory flag, withdebug file, TDLib native stream) in step by hand and ignores failures
trigger: Type 'debugmode' and confirm. Turning on: debug_mode::set_enabled(true) runs before start_tdlib_log; if TDLib rejects the stream the error note shows but the flag stays on and the file is persisted '1'. Turning off: stop_tdlib_log result is discarded (let _), so if secure_native_logging fails TDLib keeps writing debug-level tdlib.log.
effect: UI says debug logs are off (or on) while TDLib still writes (or does not write) its debug log, which the confirm text says can hold account data; next launch repeats the mismatch because hub.rs also drops the start error.
fix: One DebugLog enum {Off, On, OnButTdlibClosed(error)} owned by the app, set only after the TDLib call answered, with the failure shown and the persisted flag following the enum.

title: Partial forward failure clears the whole selection, so the failed chats cannot be retried
trigger: Tick three chats; one send fails (failed == 1 < 3). The note says 'could not forward to 1 chat' but forward stage and selection are cleared. When only the comment sent and the forward failed, a retry from scratch repeats the comment.
effect: The user must start the forward again from the message list and cannot tell which chat failed.
fix: Track per-destination outcome (Queued/Failed) in the selection; clear only queued ones and keep the box with the failed chats ticked.

title: Share box drops the forward as if it was sent when there is no live client
trigger: Select messages, open the share box, tick a chat, press Send while self.live is None and demo_session is None (connection closed, remote logout, between accounts). Neither branch runs, failed stays 0, and failed < dests.len() clears the stage and the selection.
effect: The forward draft and ticked chats vanish with no note; nothing was sent.
fix: Make submit_share return a Result and clear the stage only for destinations actually queued; with no live client keep the box and say so.

title: deselect_chat returns early on a send error and leaves session.open_chat set after the main window cleared its chat
trigger: Move the open chat to its own window while cancel_outgoing_typing or closeChat fails to send
effect: `?` at lines 122-123 skips leave_open_chat, so the session still treats the chat as shown (chat_is_shown): new messages are auto-viewed/read while the main window shows nothing; draft_clock/pending_draft were not reset
fix: Do the local teardown first (leave_open_chat), then send the TDLib closes best-effort.

title: submit_replies_block takes the box before checking the driver is active and before the send
trigger: Confirm Block in the Replies chat while locked or when the send fails.
effect: replies_block.take() closes the box; with chats_path_active false or a send Err the block is never sent and the user's choices (delete, report spam) are lost as if saved.
fix: Check active first, send, then clear the box; keep it open with an error on failure.

title: Keychain delete reports success on every error
trigger: Log out or delete an account on macOS when the keychain item is locked or the delete is refused
effect: KeychainSecretStore::delete maps Err(_) to Ok(()); the wipe path believes the database key is gone while it stays in the keychain
fix: Return Missing as Ok and map every other status to SecretStoreError::Locked/Platform, as get does.

title: Story cover editor, privacy editor and composer edit all wait on one unkeyed manage slot, so one call's answer closes another's panel as saved
trigger: In the story viewer, Save the privacy editor of a story (privacy_sent), then before its answer start another management call (Edit story > Save from the composer, or the cover editor's Save) for the same or another story. StoryManageState is one slot: the second start() takes it, so the first call's answer is ignored.
effect: When the second call answers, story_frame_upkeep sees manage.pending false and clears cover_sent, privacy_sent and save_sent together, judging success by the slot-wide manage.error (not error_for(chat, story)): the privacy panel closes as saved though its own answer was never read (it may have failed), or the composer shows the other call's error. fail_locally on another story also releases the waiters with the wrong error.
fix: Each waiter keeps the RequestId it sent (an enum Saving { request } / Editing on the panel), and the upkeep settles it only from the answer to that request; or key StoryManageState by request id instead of one slot.

title: Header menu entries are built for one chat but run on whichever chat is open at click time
trigger: Open the chat header menu (entries built in chat_navigation_menu for chat A), then open chat B (notification click, Alt+Down, link) or switch account while the popup is still showing, and click Report / Auto-Delete / Close Secret Chat / Statistics.
effect: run_header_entry re-reads session.open_chat instead of using the chat_id the entries were computed for, so the action (report box, TTL picker, close-secret-chat confirm, wallet, boost) targets chat B, and with an account switch the old account's entry list runs against the new account.
fields: chat_navigation_menu closure captures `discussion` but not chat_id
fix: Capture ChatId (an AccountChat owner key) and ScreenEpoch in the menu closure and drop the click when session.open_chat != captured.

title: Host::Asked has no way out when the answer never sets the flag
trigger: Open a session-wide box from a chat window whose request fails or is cancelled before the flag is set; later the same kind is opened by a reducer answer nothing asked for.
effect: open_box_in inserts Asked(window); only Shown entries are removed by dialog_closed_in, so the stale Asked pins the box to that window (dialog_may_show_in) instead of the window of the last press; it can show in a window the user is not in.
fix: Expire Asked when its request settles (or on the next frame in which the flag is still clear), or key it by the request that asked.

title: A save while Restore::Opening overwrites the account's saved windows with only the windows open so far
trigger: Quit/relaunch with 3 saved chat windows and 'restore' answered yes; the first restored window renders (view.rs:196 schedules a save on its first render because bounds_seen is None), 600 ms later save_chat_windows_now writes only the open windows; quit (or switch account, close_chat_windows_for_switch) before the other chats have loaded.
effect: The still-waiting windows in Restore::Opening are erased from the file (set_windows_of replaces the account's list), so they never come back on the next launch or when switching back.
fix: Make the saved list the union of open windows and the `waiting` windows of Restore::Opening (or skip saving until restore is Done); give the saver the Restore value as input.

title: A notification waiting for its avatar decode is shown with the lock state it had when queued
trigger: A message arrives from a chat whose avatar is not yet cached; lock Quill (or auto-lock fires) before the background decode ends.
effect: Waiting.locked and the already built notification (sender name and text from for_display) are shown by show_notification_as unchanged after the decode, so the OS toast carries the message text although Quill is locked (privacy).
fix: Re-read the lock when the decode ends and rebuild with for_locked_display, as show_notification_as is the single gate.

title: Reply typed in a notification window is lost when the send fails
trigger: Type a reply in Quill's own notification window for the account on screen in a chat that refuses it (no rights, closed topic, channel) and press Enter.
effect: send_inline_reply returns false and sets a silent note that says to open the chat, but the window is unlinked and the Reply click is pushed only when another account is on screen. The text is gone and the chat is not opened.
fix: On a refused send keep the reply open with the text, or push the Reply click so the chat opens; make send_inline_reply return an enum (Sent / NotHere / Refused) instead of bool.

title: A hover that never ends pauses the toast forever when its window stops drawing it
trigger: Hover the pointer on a toast, then the passcode lock engages (lock layer draws no toast), the host chat window is hidden/minimized, or the account switches.
effect: Only the rendered toast reports hover end; set_hovered(false) is never sent, so running_since stays None, deadline() is None and every later toast queues behind it (and starts paused via hovered=true) until a click.
fix: Clear hover in the lock/switch path (a Farewell for the toast) or time out hover state per frame.

title: Touch Bar observes only the first screen's composer; after an account switch the formatting popover no longer follows the selection
trigger: Install runs once and observes `app.composer` through cx.defer_in. Switch account (replace_screen builds a new OnScreen with a new composer entity). Select text in the composer.
effect: The observation is on the old, dropped entity, so a selection change in the new composer schedules no sync. The bar keeps the picker (or nothing) instead of the Format accessory until some other app notify or window activation happens to sync. Same after switching back (the A->B->A composer is again a new entity).
fix: Re-subscribe per screen: observe the composer from the OnScreen constructor / a screen-scoped hook (spawn_screen / in_screen_scope), or have the composer's selection change notify the app so observe_self covers it.

title: A cancelled or failed Touch Bar drag still saves the new pinned-chat order
trigger: Drag a pinned chat sideways on the Touch Bar past the 10 pt start distance, then let the system cancel the press (the bar is swapped for the lock/recording/player bar, the window loses key, or the recognizer fails).
effect: touch_gesture routes Cancelled/Failed to touch_ended(x, false), but touch_ended runs finish_drag whenever drag.started, ignoring the `ended` flag. The entries are reordered locally and Command::ReorderPinned is sent, so setPinnedChats saves an order the user never dropped.
fix: Make the drag one enum (Idle / Pressed{index,start_x} / Dragging{index,start_x,x}) and give Cancelled its own transition that animates back and sends nothing; only Ended in Dragging commits.

title: Touch Bar commands are not gated by the passcode lock
trigger: Tap a pinned chat or a sticker (or have a touch already in INBOX) in the ~33 ms between the lock and the throttled sync that empties the bar.
effect: run_touch_bar_command never asks refused_while_locked/lock_waits, so OpenChat opens a chat (and SendSticker sends into the open chat) behind the lock screen; the guard script does not list this entry point either.
fix: Gate run_touch_bar_command on refused_while_locked (drop the command) and list it in scripts/lock-surfaces.txt; empty the bar synchronously in set_locked.
